title: The product ϑ(y_0) ζ(π y) of cut-offs on ℝ and ℝ^P is a cut-off on ℝ^{P+1}
statement: Let P ∈ ℕ, ϑ : ℝ → ℝ and ζ : ℝ^P → ℝ be C^∞ functions with compact support. Then χ : ℝ^{P+1} → ℝ, χ(y) := ϑ(y_0) · ζ(π(y)) with π(y) = (y_1, …, y_P) = (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)), is C^∞ and has compact support.
lean_statement: ∀ (P : ℕ) (ϑ : ℝ → ℝ) (ζ : Eucl P → ℝ), ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ϑ → HasCompactSupport ϑ → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → ContDiff ℝ ((⊤ : ℕ∞) : WithTop ℕ∞) (fun y : Eucl (P + 1) => ϑ (y 0) * ζ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y)))) ∧ HasCompactSupport (fun y : Eucl (P + 1) => ϑ (y 0) * ζ ((EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin P) ℝ).symm (Fin.tail (EuclideanSpace.equiv (Fin (P + 1)) ℝ y))))
